purpose: Teach: 万事/仕業/犯さ/家宅/別居/高等裁判所/徴税/性教育

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、万事抜かりなく準備しろ
lines.en: We handle everything without oversight. Prepare thoroughly.
lines.style: Clipped, authoritative. No inflection on the opening. Steady eye contact. Weight on 'thoroughly' — not a request, an expectation. Measured breath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。不正の仕業を社内で見抜きます
lines.en: Understood. I'll identify any fraudulent activity within the company.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Measured, deliberate. Each phrase lands with quiet competence. No hesitation, no embellishment. The tone of someone who has already thought this through.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、社員のプライバシーを犯さないようにしろ
lines.en: And we don't violate staff privacy in the process.
lines.style: Stern but not harsh. Slight weight on 'violate' — this is a boundary being drawn. Controlled pause after 'process.' Testing whether Kenji understands the line.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。家宅捜索が必要な事案には法務と連携します
lines.en: Understood. For any cases requiring home searches, we'll coordinate with Legal.
lines.style: Crisp, professional. No defensive edge — he's laying out procedure. Slight emphasis on 'coordinate,' showing he understands the constraint. Steady throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、別居中の社員の事情にも配慮しろ
lines.en: Even for staff who are currently separated. We handle those circumstances with care.
lines.style: Quieter than before. More deliberate. Weight on 'separated' — acknowledging the human layer under the procedure. Slight soften in the close.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。高等裁判所での訴訟対応も準備しております
lines.en: Understood. We're also preparing for any litigation that might reach the appellate level.
lines.style: Same steady professionalism, but a notch of gravity added. He's naming the biggest-case scenario calmly. No flinch, no embellishment. Just preparation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、徴税の合法性を厳格に守れ
lines.en: We maintain strict adherence to the legality of all tax procedures.
lines.style: Emphasis on 'strict.' This is non-negotiable. Cool, measured tone. No room for interpretation. The period at the end lands like a gavel tap.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員家族への性教育支援も検討中です
lines.en: Understood. We're also reviewing support options for staff families' educational needs.
lines.style: Close on a note of expansion — showing the scope has broadened beyond legal compliance. Slight lift at the end, like opening another door. Professional but warmer than the previous exchanges.
